URL: https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/20/europe/russia-ukraine-putin-trump-intl-hnk
CNN, 20 November 2026

The ballistic missile and drone strikes – which lasted for more than six hours – killed at least five people in Kyiv and damaged key infrastructure across the capital, according to Ukrainian officials.

Russia’s defense ministry said in a post to Telegram it launched a “massive strike using high-precision weapons from land, sea, and air,” as well as drones, targeting Ukrainian military and energy facilities, port infrastructure in the Odesa region, and transport infrastructure in Kyiv.

The attack came hours after Putin left China following a day of meetings in Shenzhen with US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping. The talks failed to produce any breakthrough on Moscow’s more than four-year war in Ukraine.

Speaking from Shenzhen, Putin had vowed revenge for Ukraine’s recent attacks on a key, multibillion-dollar bridge linking Russia with the occupied Crimea.

“There will be no negotiations,” he said. “I believe our response, as I have just said, will be far more painful than what the Kyiv regime did to the bridge.”

Three bridges on the Dnipro river that flows through Kyiv were damaged in the strikes, according to mayor Vitaly Klitschko, in the latest attempt by Russia to sever transport links connecting the two sides of the capital.

Three people were killed in Kyiv, according to Klitschko, while two were killed in the western city of Lviv, according to authorities there.

“All emergency services have done and will continue to do everything possible to mitigate the consequences of the attack as quickly as possible,” Klitschko said, adding two people were also wounded in the attack.

People enter a Kyiv metro station to shelter overnight following warnings of possible Russian air attacks early on November 20, 2026.
    
  
          Roman Pilipey/AFP/Getty Images
        
      
    
    


    
            Several districts in Kyiv are without power due to the attack, according to energy company DTEK. Emergency power outages have been implemented in the Lviv, Zakarpattia, and Ivano-Frankivsk regions, according to Ukrenergo, the country’s state-owned electricity operator, which called the situation in the power grid “extremely critical.”

Putin had hailed the trilateral talks with Xi and Trump as historic and told reporters the discussions took place in a “relaxed and very intimate atmosphere.”

In his opening remarks, Putin said Russia, China and the US have “shared interests” in settling the Ukraine war.

Victoria Butenko contributed reporting.
